description: Create and validate a project-aware managed implementation plan from TRD-20260905-236FDE55, preserving its 54 requirements, draft status, design decisions, and authority boundaries. Deliver planning artifacts only.
definition_of_done: A new managed draft plan identifies the exact inspected TRD revision and digest and preserves all 54 requirement IDs, meanings, acceptance criteria, dependencies, priorities, and exclusions.
The plan defines project-aware phases and bounded tasks with target artifacts, dependencies, risks, planned checks, and complete forward and reverse requirement coverage.
Unsettled toolchain, namespace and core distribution, memory integration, and promotion-policy decisions are represented honestly with readiness effects and actionable resolution paths.
The saved plan is reopened and passes structural, dependency, coverage, projection, and catalog integrity checks; any semantic readiness blockers are reported explicitly.

The Project Director records delivery and criterion-by-criterion evidence in this separate Task while preserving the source TRD, unrelated records, reusable sources, runtime configuration, and product files.
current_summary: Managed draft delivery is complete and verified at static-check level. PLAN-20260906-87CB943F remains draft revision 1 with complete source coverage and current projections/index. Q-002 through Q-004 and five proposed decisions prevent readiness; they are represented deliverable content, not unfinished planning work. No product implementation or external action is claimed.
